headline: Kuura Strand Flares as Marban Hollow and Nevish Fronts Shift
war_summary: Kuura Strand has erupted into the war's most volatile front, posting ten base turnovers in the past two hours as Colonial forces swept forward to claim five of the sector's six strongholds. Marban Hollow has likewise reawakened from its recent lull, logging four swift exchanges around Checkpoint Bua and Oster Wall to leave three strategic positions reduced to neutral ruins. High casualties and sharp swings continue along the Nevish Line, where brutal contested fighting over Tomb Father and Blackcoat Way devoured more than twenty-five hundred men in two hours, keeping two bases in Colonial hands against six Warden redoubts. In Weathered Expanse, the bitter attrition grinds forward with another two shifts and over two thousand fresh casualties, though its operational tempo has cooled relative to earlier surges. Meanwhile, Stonecradle absorbed six base actions earlier in the afternoon around The Reach before settling, whereas Linn of Mercy, Farranac Coast, and Olavis Wake have yielded no new boundary shifts despite heavy frontline bombardment.
